event_v0.doc: `harvest` claimed a reward or swept the asset the strategy held into the underlying.\n`claimed` is what the distributor paid in this call, `swept` what went into the\nunderlying, `minted` the shares that added to `Held`.
event_v0.name: RewardsSwept

function_v0.doc: `[id_this, id_market(this, data), id_collateral(underlying)]`. `InvalidData` unless\n`data` names the underlying.
function_v0.name: ids

function_v0.doc: The underlying shares the strategy counts and the units they back.
function_v0.name: totals

function_v0.doc:
Keeper only. Claims the strategy's Merkl reward when `data` holds a claim and a
distributor is set; writes the counted shares down to the strategy's balance if that
is lower; then, with at least `MIN_SWEEP_UNITS` units outstanding, deposits every unit
of the asset the strategy holds into the underlying for every position pro rata (Q98).
A claim the distributor refuses, or a deposit the underlying refuses, changes nothing
and is not an error. `InvalidData` for a claim of the wrong shape.
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc:
Deposits `assets`, pulled from the vault, into the underlying and credits the vault
with units for the shares it minted. `change` is the position's value now minus the
value last recorded for it. The protocol total grows by `assets`, the principal put in
(Q89), less what the position's principal stood above its value (Q90).
function_v0.name: allocate

function_v0.doc:
Withdraws exactly `assets` from the underlying straight to the vault and debits the
vault with the units of the shares it burned. Never gated by approval or the protocol
cap. The protocol total loses the principal taken out (Q89), and whatever of the rest
stands above the position's value (Q90).
function_v0.name: deallocate

function_v0.doc: Value of `vault`'s position: `preview_redeem` of its shares, rounded down, read through\n`try_`; the value last recorded when the underlying cannot be read. Never fails and\nnever writes.
function_v0.name: real_assets
__constructor

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: lowers `vault`'s principal, and the protocol total by the same amount, to the
position's value when that is lower, and emits `PrincipalSynced`. Never raises it,
moves no money and reports no `change`. A position that does not exist, or an
underlying that cannot be read, is left as it is (Q90).
function_v0.name: sync_position

function_v0.doc: What `deallocate(vault, data, x)` can pay right now: the smaller of the position's\nvalue and what the underlying would pay the strategy (`max_withdraw`). 0 on malformed\n`data` or any failed read. Never writes.
function_v0.name: max_deallocate

function_v0.doc: Sum of the principal every vault has put in and not taken out (Q89).
function_v0.name: total_allocated

function_v0.doc: Cap authority only. 0 removes the cap.
function_v0.name: set_protocol_cap

function_v0.doc: The seconds the underlying takes to pay an exit larger than its idle cash, as stated\nat deployment; 0 for a vault that pays on demand. A strategy with a non-zero period\nmust not be a core vault's liquidity strategy.
function_v0.name: withdrawal_period
